items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: INTERVIEWER: I was trying to think, did you make, just a few years ago, a Riverside record when they came here? That's it. That's it. Because we were talking about Lil Armstrong. I interviewed her. INTERVIEWEE: Yes, she made it on the same time I did.

ctx.x: That's where Lil... That's where he married Lil.
Yes, with Lil. He was married to Lil.
Keppert, I believe she said was there once. Jimmy Keppert. Yeah, or no, wait, Freddie. Freddie Keppert. Freddie Keppert.
